verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a way to list a skill's instructions and scripts before installing it, or a supported way to inspect every installed file afterward. Calling the project open source is not a documented review capability. One community member also reported that the repo ships a `caveman.skill` binary they could not easily read, which points away from easy file review. The axis applies to a skill product, so the absence of evidence makes this none.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can review exactly what instructions and scripts a skill will add — list contents before installing and read every file afterward
